title: Gateway tool flattening
responsibility: Flattens tool namespaces and rejects tools the experimental gateway cannot host.

inputs.name: gatewayToolDefinitions.definitions
inputs.description: An array of gateway records to flatten. A record with type "namespace" must have an array-valued tools field; any other record is accepted only when String(type) is "function" or "custom".

outputs.name: gatewayToolDefinitions
outputs.description: A flat array of supported function and custom records. Namespace descendants receive a namespace property set to that namespace name as recursion unwinds, so an outer namespace overwrites a nested one; a missing name produces undefined, and direct supported records are returned unchanged.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when a namespace record has a non-array tools field; the message is "Invalid namespace tools". Also thrown when a non-namespace record has a stringified type other than "function" or "custom"; the message is "Unsupported hosted tool; disable it explicitly for this provider".
